semantic_fragments.content: The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer is intended for the intermittent measurement of body temperature from the forehead skin surface on people of all ages. It can be used by consumers in the household environment and by healthcare providers.

This product is a high-tech infra-red (IR) thermometer designed to take human body temperature by measuring the energy of IR emitted from the forehead. The product will help you to assess you and your family members' health conditions easily and quickly.
Box contents: 1 IR Thermometer, 2 AAA Batteries, 1 User's Manual. Use only accessories provided by the original manufacturer, and check for any missing accessories.

Warning: Use of this thermometer is not intended as a substitute for consultation with your physician. Please consult your doctor if you have any doubt about the temperature reading. Keep the thermometer out of reach of children. For accidental swallowing of the battery or other components, please contact emergency services immediately. Batteries must not be thrown into an open fire or short circuited.

测量注意事项：(1)体温计读数仅供参考，不可用于自我诊断或自我治疗；(2)人体体温无绝对标准，了解自身正常体温范围很重要；(3)测量前确保额头无汗水、化妆品、污垢或油脂；(4)淋浴、沐浴、运动和进食后需等待30分钟再测量；(5)不可在疤痕组织、开放性伤口或擦伤处测量；(6)若体温计存储环境与受测者周围环境温度不同，需将体温计在受测者环境中放置30分钟；(7)服用升温药物后不得立即测量；(8)连续测量读数可能在小范围内波动，建议短期内连续测量不超过3次；(9)测量时不可直接面对太阳、空调出风口或暖气设备；(10)不可在强电磁干扰环境中测量体温；(11)本产品应视为个人设备，须正确清洁消毒以防交叉污染；(12)在制造商规定的体温、工作温湿度及储存温湿度范围外操作，或受到机械冲击，或红外光学组件受污损，均可能影响体温计性能；(13)清洁探头时，用蘸有70%异丙醇的棉签轻轻擦拭，清洁后至少等待15分钟再进行测量。

本红外体温计符合ISO 80601-2-56:2017+A1:2018及ASTM标准(E1965-98)要求（条款5.2.2除外），显示体温范围为89.6℉~109.2℉（32℃~42.9℃）。ASTM实验室精度要求：在37~39°C（98~102°F）显示范围内，红外体温计精度要求为±0.2°C（±0.4°F）；而水银和电子体温计按ASTM标准E667-86和E1112-86要求为±0.1°C（±0.2°F）。患者为预期操作者。探头属于应用部分。在最低存储温度下，当环境温度为20℃时，体温计预热至可使用状态需要6小时；在最高存储温度下，当环境温度为20℃时，体温计冷却至可使用状态同样需要6小时。

产品使用注意事项：(1)本产品为精密设备，使用后需放回原包装存储，避免设备或探头接触液体或水滴，避免微小颗粒（如灰尘或粉末）落入探头；(2)避免跌落或受外力冲击，不得自行拆卸或重新组装；(3)不得直接用手指触摸探头或对其吹气；(4)将产品放在儿童不可触及处；(5)不得将体温计或电池投入火中；(6)超过一个月不使用时，应取出电池；(7)对塑料/橡胶过敏者不应使用本设备；(8)与患者接触的材料（ABS、TPU、PMMA、PC）已通过ISO 10993-5和ISO 10993-10标准测试，无毒性、过敏和刺激反应，符合医疗器械指令（MDD）要求；(9)本产品在与患者使用过程中不得进行维修或保养。

The thermometer is mainly comprised of a plastic casing, IR temperature sensor, MCU, LCD display screen, buzzer and batteries. Device dimensions: 5.15 in x 1.37 in x 1.49 in (131mm x 35mm x 38mm). Screen dimensions: 0.98 in x 0.7 in (25mm x 18mm). Product weight: 79g (include batteries). LCD display components include: Temperature display area, Baby temperature mode symbol, Adult temperature mode symbol, Object temperature mode symbol, Memory symbol, Progress bar symbol, Temperature unit symbol, Mute symbol, Dynamic measurement mode symbol, Battery symbol.

Product specifications: 1. Measurement position: Centre of the forehead surface. 2. Measurement distance: ≤1.18 in (3 cm). 3. Power source: DC 2 x 1.5V SIZE AAA batteries. 4. Measurement range: 89.6℉-109.2℉ (32℃-42.9℃). 5. Measurement precision: ±0.4℉/0.2℃ within 95℉-107.6℉ (35℃-42℃), and ±0.5℉/0.3℃ for other temperature ranges. 6. Resolution: 0.1℉/0.1℃. 7. Clinical reproducibility: Within ±0.5℉/0.3℃. 8. Operating conditions: Temperature: 50℉-104℉ (10℃-40℃), Humidity: 15-95%RH non-condensing, Atmospheric Pressure: 70~106kPa. 9. Transportation and storage conditions: Temperature: -4℉-131℉ (-20℃-55℃), Humidity: 15-95%RH non-condensing, Atmospheric Pressure: 70kPa~106kPa. 10. Operation mode: Adjusted mode. 11. Expected service life: 5 years. 12. Reference Body Site: Oral. 13. Software version: V1.0.

Expected use and scope of applications: This product mainly uses IR temperature sensing of the forehead to measure human body temperature. It can be used for babies, children, and adults. Babies and children should not operate the thermometer on their own. Body temperature readings for babies and children should be taken by an adult. Reminder: Temperature readings may differ according to skin tone and measurement distance. Contraindications: It is not recommended for people whose forehead has local lesions, such as inflammation, trauma, recent surgery, etc.

Setup and operating procedures: The patient is an intended operator. The patient can measure and change battery. Temperature measurement process: (1) Remove protective cap before taking a measurement. (2) Position: Aim the probe at the center of the forehead, keep probe ≤1.18 inch (3cm) away, do not touch the forehead, hold perpendicular to forehead. For object temperature, aim at object without touching. (3) Take temperature: Normal measurement mode - gently press measurement button to start. Dynamic measurement mode - press and hold button for 2 seconds to activate; takes multiple measurements for accurate readings especially for moving subjects like infants; progress bar displayed; releasing button before completion means result will not be displayed. (4) Read temperature: Confirmation beep indicates measurement complete. Baby temperature mode: 89.6℉-100.3℉ (32℃-37.9℃) = White display + 1 long beep; 100.4℉-109.2℉ (38.0℃-42.9℃) = Red display + 4 short beeps. Adult temperature mode: 89.6℉-99.4℉ (32℃-37.4℃) = White display; 99.5℉-100.3℉ (37.5℃-37.9℃) = Orange display; 100.4℉-109.2℉ (38.0℃-42.9℃) = Red display.
Confirmation beep behavior: 1 long beep / 4 short beeps / 4 short beeps (corresponding to different measurement modes).

When a measurement fails, possible reasons for measurement errors include: 1. Make sure to remove protective cap before taking a measurement; 2. The environment temperature exceeding the operational range of 50℉-104℉(10℃-40℃) or being unstable, causing the screen to display 'Err'; 3. The target temperature being outside the measurement range of 89.6℉-109.2℉(32℃-42.9℃), causing the screen to display '---', the temperature unit symbol, and the measurement mode symbol; 4. Press and hold the measurement button no more than 2 seconds in dynamic measurement mode, causing the screen to display '---', the dynamic measurement mode symbol, the temperature unit symbol, and the measurement mode symbol.

Selecting modes: The default mode is baby temperature mode. To switch between the three modes: (1) In the measurement state, press the settings button briefly to enter the mode switching state. (2) Press the settings button briefly to cycle through the baby mode, adult mode, and object temperature mode, with corresponding icons displayed on the LCD screen. (3) Press the measurement button to save the current settings and initiate a measurement process. Note: The thermometer turns off automatically after 15 seconds of inaction.

Switching units: (1) Press and hold the measurement button for 8 seconds to enter the unit switching mode. (2) The screen flashes the current unit. Press the measurement button to toggle between ℃ and ℉, then selected unit will flash, accompanied by a short beep. (3) Press and hold the measurement button for 2 seconds to confirm the setting, the current unit ℃ or ℉ will light up for 3 seconds, accompanied by a short beep. And then the thermometer turns off automatically. Note: The thermometer will automatically turn off after 15 seconds of inactivity, and the selected unit will also be saved automatically even if without pressing the measurement button for confirmation.

Memory Mode: Press and hold the settings button for 3 seconds to enter the memory mode, and the memory icon 'M' will flash simultaneously. Release and use the settings button to toggle between the different memories, and latest memory will be shown as the first memory. If you want to view more memories of other modes, please choose your desired mode at first. Note: The thermometer turns off automatically after 15 seconds of inaction.

Memory Deletion Mode: In the power-off state, press and hold the measurement button and the settings button simultaneously for 8 seconds until the icon of 'dEL' and 'M' flash on screen. After 2 seconds, all memories will be deleted, and only the 'dEL' icon shows up on screen. And the thermometer will turn off automatically after 3 seconds.
Mute setting: Toggle the mute switch on the side of the thermometer to mute or unmute the device.

Low battery alert: Once switched ON for use, the thermometer will automatically detect remaining battery capacity. If battery capacity is low but adequate for measurements, the low power symbol will be displayed with the measurement results. However, if the battery capacity is too low for measurements, the screen will display a flashing low battery icon and automatically switch OFF after 15 seconds. To continue using the device, batteries must be replaced.
Power off: The thermometer turns off automatically after 15 seconds of inaction.

Replacing batteries instructions and safety warnings: (1) Press down the battery cover and slide the cover to open the battery compartment. (2) Remove the old batteries and install new batteries. (3) Refer to the battery polarity symbols to orient the batteries properly during installation. Make sure that the new batteries are tightly inserted into the battery compartment and the polarity is not reversed during installation. (4) Reinstall the battery cover to close the battery compartment. Safety notes: Comply with relevant state and local laws and regulations when disposing of the used batteries. For environmental safety, please do not discard batteries in the trash. Remove the batteries if the device will not be used more than one month. When using, shall not touch battery and the patient simultaneously. Do not throw batteries into fire. The typical service life of the new and unused batteries is approximately 1,000 measurements, and the service life may vary among different brands of batteries.

Error/warning indicator behaviors and corrective actions: Battery depleted icon → Replace old batteries with new ones. Wrong polarity/improper installation icon → Take out and re-install batteries correctly. Low battery (measurement blocked) icon → Replace the batteries. Dynamic measurement failed / target temperature outside range 89.6℉-109.2℉ (32℃-42.9℃) icons → Press and hold measurement button to restart dynamic measurement until result displayed; remove protective cap before measurement; follow User's Manual and repeat measurements. Environment temperature exceeds operational range 50℉-104℉ (10℃-40℃) or is unstable icon → Use thermometer within designed ambient temperature range. All symbols flashing (product not usable) icon → Contact Customer Services. Low battery capacity icon → Replace battery as soon as possible.

Temperature-taking hints: Body temperature varies from person to person and fluctuates during the day. It is suggested to know one's normal, healthy forehead temperature. Body temperature runs approximately from 95.9℉ to 99.5℉ (35.5℃–37.5℃). A rise over reference body temperature of 1℉ or more is generally an indication of fever. Different measurement sites give different readings; do not compare measurements taken from different sites.

Maintenance instructions: The thermometer is designed for home use. Between multiple users, clean the device using an alcohol swab or tissue moistened with 70% Isopropyl alcohol for more than 15 seconds; allow to dry for at least 5 minutes before use; repeat if not visually clean under magnification and adequate lighting. Cleaning steps validated per FDA Guidance 'Reprocessing Medical Devices in Health Care Settings: Validation Methods and Labeling'. The product is not waterproof — no liquid must enter the interior. Do not use abrasive cleaning agents, thinners, or benzene; never immerse in water or other cleaning liquids. Clean the probe gently with a cotton swab soaked in 70% Isopropyl. If probe/sensor is broken, contact customer services. iHealth Labs, Inc. has not authorized any agency or individual to carry out product repairs or maintenance. Do not disassemble or modify the thermometer. Do not place under direct sunlight, high temperature, or moist environments; avoid fire or harsh vibrations. Remove battery if device is not used for one month or more.

Disposal instructions: Dispose of batteries in accordance with local regulations. In EU countries, dispose of batteries at public collection points per 2012/19/EU WEEE Directive and REGULATION (EU) 2023/1542 Directive. Act according to local laws for disposal of used batteries. Remove batteries if the device will not be used for more than one month. Dispose of empty batteries at appropriate collection sites according to national or local regulations.

The thermometer is initially calibrated at the time of manufacture. If this thermometer is used according to the use instruction, periodic re-adjustment is not required. If any time your question the accuracy of measurement, please contact customer support of the distributor. The contact information is on the last page of the User's Manual.

The Infrared No-Touch Forehead Thermometer corresponds to the following standards: IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012+A2:2020/ EN 60601-1:2006/A2:2021; IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020; ISO 80601-2-56:2017+A1:2018/ EN ISO 80601-2-56:2017/A1:2020; ASTM E1965-98(2023).

Electromagnetic compatibility information: The essential performance is accuracy of the clinical thermometer. When electromagnetic interference affects the above performance, please stop using this device. Use of this equipment adjacent to or stacked with other equipment should be avoided because it could result in improper operation. If such use is necessary, this equipment and the other equipment should be observed to verify that they are operating normally. Use of accessories, transducers and cables other than those specified or provided by the manufacturer of this equipment could result in increased electromagnetic emissions or decreased electromagnetic immunity of this equipment and result in improper operation. Portable RF communications equipment (including peripherals such as antenna cables and external antennas) should be used no closer than 30 cm (12 inches) to any part of the PT9L, including cables specified by the manufacturer. Otherwise, degradation of the performance of this equipment could result.

Standard icons description: The operation guide must be read (blue background, white symbol). Batteries and electronic instruments must be disposed of in accordance with locally applicable regulation, not with domestic waste. Manufacturer icon. Warning icon. Batch Code icon. European Representative icon. IP code: protection against solid foreign objects ≥12.5mm diameter (finger access to hazardous parts); waterproof grade is dripping (15° tilted). Type BF Applied Parts.

Warranty terms: 1. The warranty period for device is one year from date of delivery. Proof of delivery required via sales receipt or invoice. 2. Repairs under warranty do not extend the warranty period. 3. Excluded from warranty: damage due to improper treatment or nonobservance of user instruction; damage due to repairs or tampering by customer or unauthorized third parties; damage during transport from manufacturer to consumer or to service center; accessories subject to normal wear and tear. 4. Liability for direct or indirect consequential losses caused by the unit is excluded even if the damage is accepted as a warranty claim. 5. Contact customer services for assistance during warranty period.
